title: In This World Your Shadow Walks Off At Sunset
description: Natsu's shadow keeps coming home late, so one night she follows it to the lighthouse. What would your shadow be waiting for? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Natsu: 11-year-old Japanese girl, short black bob with a yellow hair clip, faded red T-shirt, navy shorts, white canvas sneakers, no hat
characters.Grandma: 80-year-old Japanese woman, small and bent, gray hair in a low bun, dark green cardigan with a pale lavender knitted shawl over her shoulders, brown skirt, no hat

scenes.say: In this world, every shadow walks off alone at sunset and comes back at dawn. But in one small seaside town, eleven-year-old Natsu's shadow has started coming back late.
scenes.video: [0-4s] A quiet seaside town street at orange sunset, a few dark shadows peel off the pavement and stroll away on their own toward the sea. [4-7s] Medium shot of Natsu on her wooden house porch watching her own shadow walk off down the street. [7-10s] Dawn on the same porch, Natsu in pajamas frowning as her shadow slips back under her feet.

scenes.say: One minute late. Then seven. Then forty. Natsu used to walk to the old lighthouse every evening with Grandma. Since the funeral, two hundred days ago, she hasn't gone once.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up of Natsu at her bedroom window at dawn, waiting, the street outside empty. [4-7s] Soft memory: Natsu and Grandma in her lavender shawl walking hand in hand up a cliff path to a white lighthouse at sunset. [7-10s] Natsu alone in the small kitchen of the seaside house, looking at Grandma's empty chair.

scenes.say: So tonight she breaks the town's only rule: never follow your shadow. She sneaks out barefoot and trails a thin dark shape up the cliff path to the lighthouse.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Natsu quietly slides open the wooden door of her seaside house at dusk. [4-7s] Wide shot of the grassy cliff path, Natsu barefoot following her long shadow walking ahead of her. [7-10s] Low angle, the shadow climbs the stone steps of the white lighthouse, Natsu close behind.

scenes.say: At the top of the stairs, her shadow sits down beside another shadow. A small, bent shadow, with nobody standing above it. It still wears the outline of Grandma's shawl.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside the top of the lighthouse, moonlight through the glass, Natsu reaches the last step. [4-7s] On the wooden floor her shadow sits next to a small bent shadow with a shawl outline and no person above it. [7-10s] Close-up of Natsu's face, eyes filling with tears, hand over her mouth.

scenes.say: Grandma's shadow has come here every single night, waiting for their evening walk. Natsu's shadow kept slipping away to sit with her, so she wouldn't wait alone.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Montage in the lighthouse room on different nights: the bent shadow sitting alone looking at the sea. [4-7s] Natsu's shadow arrives and sits beside it, the two shadows leaning together. [7-10s] Natsu kneels down between the two shadows on the lighthouse floor, the sea glowing behind the glass.

scenes.say: At sunrise, Grandma's shadow strokes Natsu's hair, the way Grandma always did, then fades into the light. In this world, shadows walk off alone. Tomorrow, Natsu walks with hers.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Dawn light fills the lighthouse room, the bent shadow's hand gently touches the shadow of Natsu's hair on the floor. [4-7s] The bent shadow softly fades into the golden sunrise light. [7-10s] Natsu walks down the cliff path toward the seaside town, her own shadow walking right beside her, both small and calm.
